methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with record bookings ($45.5B in FY19); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2018 10-K names off-shore providers, 'in lower-cost locations, particularly in India, that offer services globally that are similar to the services and solutions we offer', among its competitors and says competitors 'may be willing, at times, to price contracts lower than us' and 'may also offer more aggressive contractual terms', and that its global delivery capability 'is concentrated in India and the Philippines', while its own global delivery capability spans 'more than 50 delivery centers around the world' (no delivery headcount given since the FY2016 10-K's about 285,000 people). The stock trades at 23.7x FY20E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

Live: Accenture's own FY2018 10-K says 'Examples of areas of significant change include digital-, cloud- and security-related offerings, which are continually evolving, as well as developments in areas such as artificial intelligence, augmented reality, automation, blockchain, Internet of Things, quantum computing and as-a-service solutions. ... Some of these technologies have reduced and replaced some of our historical services and solutions and may continue to do so in the future.' At the same time it reports 'growing demand to assist clients with the operation and maintenance of digital-related services and cloud enablement'. The stock trades at 23.7x FY20E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of ACN's outsourcing specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with record bookings ($45.5B in FY19); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 4.96x; +58% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.84; conservative 2yr -8%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY08-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.0%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.0%/yr (FY08-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +20.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2019-10-25) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.96x (37.7% downside to Bear $114 / +7.6% upside to Bull $197) | Adj composite 2.81 vs market 3.65: gap -0.84 [OVERVALUED] | +58% above the EPP floor $116 (15x FY20E $7.73) | Conservative 2-yr case: -7.7% total (-3.9%/yr) | At 23.7x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $242 sits above the BULL case; consulting +7% LC in Q4, Q1 guided +5-8% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
